blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: False negatives remain a critical limitation of computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems for breast cancer screening due to delayed detection and treatment. To address this issue, we propose a counterfactual data augmentation strategy that generates healthy mammograms by "erasing" lesions from anomalous images, thereby enriching the training distribution. We train a Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model on BI-RADS 1 (healthy) mammograms and use a RePaint-based sampling strategy to inpaint realistic normal tissue within annotated lesion bounding boxes. The resulting healthy counterfactuals replace annotated lesion regions with realistic healthy tissue while preserving patient-specific anatomical structure, as supported by similarity metrics between real and generated images. Image realism was further assessed by radiologists and found to be consistent with the original dataset quality. We evaluate counterfactual augmentation across four representative classifier architectures: a convolutional neural network (ConvNeXt), a vision transformer (ViT), a vision-language model pre-trained on mammogram-report pairs (Mammo-CLIP) and a multi-scale attention-based multiple-instance learning framework (FPN-MIL). Experiments conducted on the VinDr-Mammo dataset show improvements in sensitivity across all architectures, particularly at 80\% fixed specificity, contributing towards more reliable CAD systems for breast cancer. Code is available at: https://github.com/ines03garcia/diffusion-based-counterfactual-generation.
blocks.zh: 由于检测和治疗延迟,假阴性仍然是计算机辅助乳腺癌筛查诊断系统的一个重要限制。 为了解决这个问题,我们提出了反事实数据增强策略,通过异常图像的"消除"损伤产生健康的乳房X光图,从而丰富培训分布. 我们在BI-RADS 1(健康)乳房X光图上训练一种Denoising diffusion Probabilistic模型,并使用基于RePaint的采样策略,在附加说明的损伤方块内涂抹现实的正常组织. 由此产生的健康反事实用现实的健康组织取代附加说明的损伤区域,同时保留患者特有的解剖结构,真实图像和生成图像之间的相似性测量也以此为佐证。 图像现实主义被放射学家进一步评估,发现与原始数据集质量一致. 我们评价四个有代表性的分类结构的反事实增强:一个革命神经网络(ConvNEXt)、一个视觉变压器(ViT)、一个对乳腺图-报告对(Mammo-CLIP)进行预先训练的视觉语言模型和一个基于注意力的多进取学习框架(FPN-MIL)。 在VinDr-Mammo数据集上进行的实验显示,所有结构的敏感性都有所提高,特别是在80\%固定特异性方面,有助于建立更可靠的乳腺癌CAD系统。 代码见:https://github.com/ines03garcia/difmusion-based-counterfact-generation.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
False negatives in breast cancer detection systems are associated with delayed diagnosis and worse patient outcomes. Although mammography remains the primary modality for early breast cancer screening, its sensitivity is affected by multiple factors, including inter-patient anatomical variability [ 1 ] .
Beyond missed detections, an additional concern in computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) is whether predictions are driven by clinically meaningful evidence. Deep learning models may achieve strong aggregate performance while relying on spurious correlations rather than lesion-specific cues [ 13 ] . Such effects have been observed in breast imaging settings [ 24 ] . For clinical deployment, CAD systems must not only improve sensitivity but also ensure that predictions are based on regions of interest (ROI) [ 22 ] .
blocks.zh:
乳腺癌检测系统中的假阴性与诊断延迟和病人结果更糟糕有关。 虽然乳房X光检查仍然是早期乳腺癌筛查的主要方式,但其敏感性受到多种因素的影响,包括患者间解剖变异性[1].
除了未发现外,计算机辅助诊断(CAD)中的另一个关切是预测是否由临床上有意义的证据驱动. 深层学习模式可以实现强的聚合性能,同时依赖于虚假的关联性而不是针对损伤的提示 [13]. 在乳房成像环境中观察到了这种影响。 就临床部署而言,CAD系统不仅必须提高敏感性,而且必须确保预测基于感兴趣的区域[22]。

blocks.en:
Counterfactuals represent ’what-if’ scenarios, such as: how would this patient’s mammogram look if there were no findings? Diffusion models have emerged as a leading approach for high-fidelity image generation [ 2 ] . Building on the Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) framework, these methods iteratively learn to reverse a gradual noise corruption process, enabling the sampling of images from random Gaussian noise. Commonly used to synthesize medical images [ 27 ] , including X-rays [ 25 ] and breast MRIs [ 11 ] , diffusion models have been recently explored for mammogram generation [ 18 ] .
Focusing on counterfactuals, their applications include data augmentation [ 8 ] , explainability [ 6 ] and classifier performance enhancement [ 4 ] , but a critical challenge remains the unintended modification of unrelated morphology [ 16 ] . To address this, our approach restricts modifications to previously annotated lesion regions by employing masked diffusion inpainting. The inpainted area is iteratively conditioned on the surrounding tissue, ensuring anatomical coherence while preventing unintended modifications outside the annotated bounding box. Rather than generating lesions, an approach hindered by data scarcity, high anomaly variability, and complex distributional patterns [ 26 ] , we generate healthy counterfactuals, i.e., anatomically plausible normal counterparts of originally abnormal images.
Although healthy counterfactuals have previously been explored in mammography [ 21 ] , their use as a data augmentation strategy remains largely underexplored. By incorporating these counterfactuals into the training set of four diverse classifier architectures, we aim to enhance the robustness of CAD systems for breast cancer detection. Specifically, we select architectures with distinct inductive biases: a convolutional neural network (ConvNeXt) [ 14 ] , a transformer-based vision model (ViT) [ 3 ] , a mammography-specific image encoder (Mammo-CLIP) [ 7 ] and a multiple-instance learning classifier (FPN-MIL) [ 17 ] .
blocks.zh:
反事实代表了“如果”的情景,例如:如果没有发现,这名病人的乳房X光照片会怎样看? 传播模式已出现,成为高真实度图像生成的主导方法[2]. 这些方法在Denoising Difusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) 框架的基础上,迭代地学习了扭转逐渐的噪声腐败过程,从而能够从随机高斯噪声中取样图像. 通常用于合成医疗影像[27],包括X-射线[25]和乳房MRIs[11],最近探索了乳房外观生成[18]的传播模型.
其以反事实为重点,其应用包括数据增强[8],可解释性[6]和分类器性能增强[4],但关键的挑战仍然是无意地修改无关形态[16]. 为了解决这一问题,我们的做法通过使用遮盖的传播涂漆,将修改限制在先前附加说明的损伤区域。 被涂入的区域反复地以周围的组织为条件,确保解剖的一致性,同时防止附加说明的框外的出乎意料的修改. 我们不但没有产生伤害,而是产生由数据稀缺、异常多变性高和复杂分布模式[26]所阻碍的伤害,而是产生健康的反事实,即从解剖学上看,原本异常图像的正常对应物。
虽然此前在乳房X光检查中曾探索过健康的反事实[21],但作为数据增强策略的使用仍然在很大程度上未得到充分探讨. 通过将这些反事实纳入四种不同分类结构的培训集,我们的目标是加强乳腺癌检测的CAD系统的稳健性。 具体地说,我们选择了具有明显入微偏差的建筑:一个进取神经网络(ConvNEXt)[14],一个基于变压器的视觉模型(ViT)[3],一个乳房造影特殊图像编码器(Mammo-CLIP)[7]和一个多进取学习分类器(FPN-MIL)[17].

blocks.en: Comparative evaluation on the VinDr-Mammo dataset against standard augmentation baselines demonstrates consistent sensitivity gains, particularly at a clinically relevant operating point of 80% specificity, supporting healthy counterfactual augmentation as a strategy for reducing missed detections in mammography classification.
blocks.zh: 对照标准增强基线对VinDr-Mammo数据集进行的比较评价显示,特别是在具有临床相关性的80%特异性操作点,持续提高了敏感度,支持健康的反事实增强,以此作为减少乳房X光学分类中误测的战略。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: To investigate whether counterfactuals enhance deep learning classifiers for mammography, we propose a three-stage pipeline (Figure 1 ). First, a DDPM [ 10 ] is trained exclusively on BI-RADS 1 mammograms to model the distribution of normal breast tissue. Second, the RePaint [ 15 ] sampling mechanism is employed to inpaint healthy tissue within annotated lesion bounding boxes, producing healthy counterfactuals. Third, the synthetic images are incorporated into the training set to obtain counterfactual-augmented models.
blocks.zh: 为了调查反事实是否增强乳房X光学的深层学习分类,我们提议采用三阶段的管道(图一. 首先,专用BI-RADS 1型乳房X线X线X线X线X线X线X(DDPM [10])训练,以模拟正常乳房组织的分布. 第二,采用RePaint[15]取样机制,将健康组织涂入有注释的损伤框内,产生健康的反事实。 第三,将合成图像纳入培训,以获得反事实强化模型。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the proposed pipeline. First, a DDPM is trained on healthy mammograms to learn the distribution of healthy breast tissue. Second, RePaint is used to generate healthy counterfactuals via mask-guided inpainting of lesion regions, using binary masks derived from bounding-box annotations. Finally, the generated counterfactuals are incorporated into the training set for classification.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议管道概览。 首先,对DDPM进行健康乳房X线检查的培训,以了解健康乳房组织分布情况。 第二,RePaint被用于通过口罩制导的损伤区域涂入来生成健康的反事实,使用从边框说明中衍生出来的二进制口罩. 最后,生成的反事实已纳入分类培训。

blocks.en: 2.1 Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM)
blocks.zh: 2.1 排除扩散概率模型

blocks.en: We train a DDPM [ 10 ] with a U-Net backbone to model the distribution of healthy mammograms (BI-RADS 1). Following the standard diffusion framework, Gaussian noise is progressively added to images according to a predefined variance schedule, defining a forward noising process. The network is trained to predict the injected noise at each timestep by minimizing a mean squared error (MSE) objective, thereby learning the corresponding denoising process. In inference, sampling is performed by iteratively denoising random Gaussian noise using the learned reverse transitions. Training exclusively on healthy images enables the model to capture normal breast anatomy for subsequent counterfactual generation.
blocks.zh: 我们训练一个DDPM [10] 有U-Net主干线,以模拟健康乳房X光图(BI-RADS 1)的分布. 遵循标准扩散框架,高斯噪声按照预先设定的相差表被逐渐添加到图像中,定义了前向噪声过程. 网络通过将平均平方误差(MSE)目标最小化,从而学习相应的去诺化过程,在每一时段都接受过预测注入噪声的培训. 在推论中,采样是通过利用所学到的倒转来迭代去命名随机高斯噪音来进行. 专门对健康图像进行培训,使模型能够捕捉正常的乳房解剖学,从而产生反事实。

blocks.en: 2.2 RePaint Inpainting
blocks.zh: 2.2 重新绘画

blocks.en: We use RePaint [ 15 ] to perform mask-conditioned diffusion inpainting. Given a binary lesion mask M M , known pixels are re-noised to the current timestep, while masked regions are updated via the learned reverse transition. At each step: x t − 1 = M ⊙ x t − 1 known + ( 1 − M ) ⊙ x ^ t − 1 . x_{t-1}=M\odot x^{\text{known}}_{t-1}+(1-M)\odot\hat{x}_{t-1}. where x t − 1 x_{t-1} denotes the resulting image at timestep t − 1 t-1 , x t − 1 known x^{\mathrm{known}}_{t-1} represents the region to preserve with corresponding noise at t − 1 t-1 , and x ^ t − 1 \hat{x}_{t-1} denotes the newly generated content based on x t x_{t} . The operator ⊙ \odot represents element-wise multiplication.

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en:
We conduct experiments on the publicly available VinDr-Mammo dataset [ 19 ] , preprocessed by [ 7 ] . The dataset comprises 5,000 full-field digital mammography exams, each containing four standard views: craniocaudal (CC) and mediolateral oblique (MLO) views of both breasts, totalling 20,000 mammograms. Following the original data splits and folds, 16,000 images (80%) were used for training and 4,000 (20%) for testing.
To balance anatomical fidelity and computational efficiency during counterfactual generation, mammograms were resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels using zero padding to preserve aspect ratio. Synthesized images were later resized back to their original resolution of 1520 × 912 1520\times 912 pixels. Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) was applied to normalize local contrast across mammograms.
blocks.zh:
我们对公开的VinDr-Mammo数据集进行实验[19],由[7]进行预处理. 数据集由5 000个全场数字乳房X射线照相考试组成,每个考试包含四个标准视图:胸腔和双乳房中度斜视,共计20 000个乳房X射线照相。 在原始数据分拆和折叠后,有16 000个图像(80%)用于培训,4 000个图像(20%)用于测试。
为了在反事实生成过程中平衡解剖忠诚度和计算效率,乳房外观被调整为512×512 512\times 512像素,使用零活塞来保持相相比. 合成图像后来被调整回原分辨率为1520×912 1520\times 912像素. 将对比性有限适应直方图等效化(CLAHE)用于使乳腺图的局部对比正常化。

blocks.en: 3.2 Counterfactual Generation
blocks.zh: 3.2 反事实生成

blocks.en: DDPM Training
blocks.zh: DDPM 服务器 培训

blocks.en: The DDPM was trained on BI-RADS 1 mammograms using an NVIDIA A100 GPU with 80 GB of memory. Although BI-RADS 2 corresponds to benign findings, these cases were excluded from this training stage to avoid generation of any lesion-like structures. We used the OpenAI guided-diffusion implementation in PyTorch. The model is based on a U-Net backbone with 256 base channels and was trained on single-channel images resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixels. Training used an MSE noise-prediction objective with a linear variance schedule over 1,000 diffusion timesteps, with an AdamW optimizer ( LR = 1 × 10 − 4 \mathrm{LR}=1\times 10^{-4} , batch size=16), for approximately 8,000 iterations until validation loss convergence.
blocks.zh: DDPM在BI-RADS 1乳房X光图上接受了训练,使用的是一款有80GB内存的NVIDIA A100GPU. 虽然BI-RADS 2符合良性结论,但这些病例被排除在培训阶段之外,以避免产生任何类似损伤的结构。 我们在PyTorch使用了OpenAI的引导扩散执行. 该模型以有256个基道的U-Net为主干线为主干线,并接受了被调整为512×512 512\times 512像素的单通道图像培训. 训练使用一个MSE噪声预测目标,线性相差分出1000个扩散时间步,有亚当W优化器(LR = 1× 10− 4\mathrm{LR}=1\times 10^{-4},分批大小=16个),用于大约8000个重迭到验证损失汇合.

blocks.en: Sampling using RePaint
blocks.zh: 使用 RePaint 进行取样

blocks.en: The trained DDPM was integrated into the RePaint mechanism to generate lesion-free counterfactual mammograms. For each anomalous image, a binary lesion mask was constructed from the annotated bounding box, with lesion pixels set to 0 (to be inpainted) and surrounding tissue set to 1 (to be preserved).
blocks.zh: 训练有素的DDPM被整合入RePaint机制,以生成无损伤反事实乳房X光图. 对于每个反常图像,从注解的边框中构建出二进制损伤口罩,损伤像素被设定为0(被涂入),周围组织被设定为1(被保存).

blocks.en: Sampling was performed using mask-conditioned reverse diffusion with 500 respaced timesteps to improve computational efficiency. At each timestep, known regions were re-noised and reinserted to preserve anatomical context, while masked regions were updated according to the learned reverse transition. One counterfactual image was generated per anomalous annotated mammogram and subsequently added to the training set.
blocks.zh: 取样采用带有500个重排时间步的口罩条件反向扩散,以提高计算效率。 在每个时间段,已知区域被重新点名并重新插入,以保留解剖背景,而被掩盖的区域则根据所学到的倒转来更新. 在附加说明的乳房X光图中生成了一个反事实图像,随后添加到培训集中。

blocks.en: 3.3 Counterfactual Augmentation
blocks.zh: 3.3 反事实增强

blocks.en: To evaluate the impact of counterfactual augmentation across different inductive biases, we selected four classifiers: ConvNeXt [ 14 ] as a hierarchical CNN, ViT [ 3 ] for modelling long-range dependencies, Mammo-CLIP [ 7 ] as a VinDr-Mammo pretrained encoder, and FPN-MIL [ 17 ] for weakly supervised multi-scale aggregation.
blocks.zh: 为了评价反事实增强对不同诱导偏差的影响,我们选择了四个分类器:ConvNEXt [14]作为分级的CNN,用于建模远程依赖的Vit [3],Mammo-CLIP [7]作为VinDr-Mammo预先训练的编码器,以及FPN-MIL [17]作为弱监督的多尺度聚合.

blocks.en: ConvNeXt and ViT were initialized with ImageNet-pretrained weights, while Mammo-CLIP and FPN-MIL used EfficientNet backbones pretrained on VinDr-Mammo. Models were fine-tuned using binary cross-entropy loss, AdamW ( LR = 3 × 10 − 4 \mathrm{LR}=3\times 10^{-4} ), a batch size of 8, cosine annealing and positive class weighting to account for the imbalance between healthy and anomalous samples.
blocks.zh: ConvNEXt和ViT以ImageNet预受器重进行初始化,而Mammo-CLIP和FPN-MIL则使用VinDr-Mammo预受器重. 模型采用二进制横切损耗来进行微调,AdamW(LR = 3× 10− 4\mathrm{LR}=3\times 10×4}),批量尺寸为8,同位素厌足和正分级加权,以说明健康样品与异常样品之间的不平衡.

blocks.en: Models were first trained using 4-fold cross-validation to estimate an appropriate training duration. Three folds of the training set were used for model fitting, while the remaining fold, comprising 3,200 images, was used for validation. The optimal number of epochs was averaged across folds and subsequently used to retrain each model on the full training set. For counterfactual augmentation, one healthy counterfactual was generated for each annotated image, adding 1,410 negative samples to the training set, increasing the size of the negative class by 13%. Positive-class weights were recalculated after augmentation to account for the resulting change in class distribution.
blocks.zh: 最初对模型进行了4倍交叉验证,以估计适当的培训期限。 培训套装采用三叠装来进行模型安装,其余由3 200个图像组成的套装用于验证。 最佳的时代数被各折叠平均,后被用来在全套训练集上重新训练出每个模型. 在反事实增强方面,每个附加说明的图像都生成一个健康的反事实,在训练集中增加了1,410个负分样本,将负分班的大小增加了13%. 增量后对正等重量进行再计算,以考虑到由此造成的阶级分布的变化。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: We evaluated the realism and clinical plausibility of the generated counterfactuals through distributional metrics and radiologists’ studies. The effectiveness of the proposed data augmentation is assessed using standard classification performance metrics. We did not perform matched-pair prediction-consistency analysis because its interpretation of what the classifier’s learning is limited in the context of counterfactual image generation.
blocks.zh: 我们通过分布测量和放射学家的研究,评估了所产生的反事实的现实性和临床可信性。 采用标准分类业绩衡量标准评估拟议数据扩充的有效性。 我们没有进行匹配的预测-一致性分析,因为它在反事实图像生成方面对分类者学习内容的解释有限。

blocks.en: 4.1 Healthy Counterfactual Generation Quality Assessment
blocks.zh: 4.1 健康反事实生成质量评估

blocks.en: Distributional Metrics
blocks.zh: 分布计量

blocks.en: We evaluate the realism of the generated images using distributional metrics based on the Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) [ 9 ] and two variants of the Fréchet Radiomic Distance (FRD) [ 12 ] , which assess perceptual quality and radiomic consistency.
blocks.zh: 我们根据Fréchet受体距离[9]和Fréchet射电距离[12]的两个变体,利用分布度量来评估生成的图像的真实性,这些变体评估了知觉质量和射电一致性。

blocks.en: Table 1 shows the results obtained with our approach, where the low FID and FRD values suggest that the edits remain close to the distribution of real healthy mammograms. We also report results from MammoFlow [ 5 ] on VinDr-Mammo, although their results are for full image generation and are not restricted to healthy cases.
blocks.zh: 表1显示了通过我们的方法获得的结果,其中低FID值和FRD值表明,编辑量仍然接近真正健康的乳房X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线收发量. 我们还报告在VinDr-Mammo上的MammoFlow[5]的结果,尽管其结果是为了产生完整的图像,并不限于健康病例。

blocks.en: We also assess only the generated patch by cropping each counterfactual to the edited bounding-box region and compare the generated healthy patches with real healthy patches from VinDr-Mammo. Our scores are better than those reported by Osuala et al. [ 20 ] , who evaluate synthetic mass patches against real mass patches from the CBIS-DDSM [ 23 ] . Although the datasets and patch types differ, our results indicate competitive realism.
blocks.zh: 我们只评估生成的补丁, 将每个反事实切入编辑的边框区域, 我们的得分比奥苏阿拉等人报告的好. [20],根据CBIS-DDSM的真质量补丁评价合成质量补丁[23]. 虽然数据集和补丁类型不同,但我们的结果显示竞争现实主义。

blocks.en: Table 1: Quantitative comparison of image realism, measured by FID, and radiomic consistency, measured by FRD, between generated and real mammograms. Lower values indicate greater similarity to the corresponding real-image distribution. Results from the proposed method are shown in bold. Prior results are included for reference, although they are not directly comparable due to differences in protocol.
blocks.zh: 表1:由FID测得的图像现实性与由FRD测得的辐射一致性在生成与真实乳房外观之间的定量比较. 更低的数值表明与相应的真象分布更相似. 拟议方法的结果以黑体表示。 列入先前的结果供参考,尽管由于协议的不同,这些结果不具有直接可比性。

blocks.en: Expert Reader Study
blocks.zh: 专家读者研究

blocks.en: To complement the metrics-based evaluation, we conducted two expert assessments of the generated healthy counterfactual mammograms: a blind review by an experienced radiologist and a broader inspection of counterfactuals involving multiple radiologists.
blocks.zh: 为了补充以衡量为基础的评价,我们对产生的健康反事实乳房X线照片进行了两次专家评估:由经验丰富的放射学家进行盲目审查,并对涉及多个放射学家的反事实进行更广泛的检查。

blocks.en: An experienced radiologist with over 35 years of experience blindly evaluated 70 healthy counterfactual mammograms and 30 real healthy mammograms. Each image was rated on a five-point Likert scale in two stages: first for full-image realism, assessing whether the image could plausibly resemble a real mammogram, and then for regional healthiness, assessing whether the tissue within the bounding box appeared healthy.
blocks.zh: 一位35年以上经验丰富的放射学家盲目地评价了70个健康反事实乳房外观和30个真正的健康乳房外观. 每个图像被评为分两个阶段的五分相像尺度:第一是全相像现实主义,评估图像能否与真实的乳房X光相像,后是区域健康,评估约束框内的组织是否显得健康.

blocks.en: The rating distributions are shown in Fig. 2 . For full-image realism, both real and counterfactual mammograms were frequently assigned intermediate ratings (2–3). Counterfactuals showed a slight shift toward lower ratings, indicating a small reduction in perceived realism. A similar trend was observed in the bounding-boxes healthiness assessment: regions from real healthy mammograms received higher ratings than counterfactual regions, although both distributions remained concentrated within a similar range (3–4).
blocks.zh: 评分分布在图2中显示。对于全图像现实主义,真实和反事实的乳房X线摄影经常被分配到中间评分(2至3分). 反事实显示,评级稍有下降,表明所认为的现实主义略有下降。 边框健康评估也呈现出类似趋势:真正的健康乳房X线片区得到的评级高于反事实区,尽管这两个分布仍集中在相近范围内(3至4个)。

blocks.en: The radiologist also noted several quality limitations in the original dataset, including low contrast, unrealistic soft-tissue appearance, implausible superposition in the axillary region and incomplete breast coverage, with some mammograms cropping posterior or inferior tissue. These observations suggest that part of the perceived lack of realism may reflect limitations already present in the source images rather than artifacts introduced by counterfactual generation.
blocks.zh: 放射学家也注意到了原始数据集中的一些质量限制,包括低对比度,不现实的软质组织外观,轴地上难以想象的叠加和乳房覆盖不完整,有些乳房外观在后方或下层组织上收成. 这些观察表明,部分被认为缺乏现实主义可能反映了来源图像已经存在的局限性,而不是反事实生成所引入的文物.

blocks.en: These findings indicate that the counterfactual edits introduced some perceptible differences, but their ratings remain broadly aligned with those of real healthy mammograms.
blocks.zh: 这些调查结果表明,反事实编辑带来了一些可察觉的差别,但其收视率仍然与真正健康的乳房X光检查大体一致.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Distribution of radiologist ratings for real healthy mammograms and generated healthy counterfactuals. Ratings were assigned on a five-point Likert scale. For the full-image assessment, higher scores indicated that an image was more likely to resemble a real mammogram; for the bounding-box assessment, higher scores indicated that the highlighted tissue was more likely to resemble healthy breast tissue.
blocks.zh: 图 2:对真正健康的乳房X光检查进行放射科医生评分,并产生健康的反事实. 评分按5分Irikrt分级分配. 就全图像评估而言,较高的分数表明,图像更可能与真正的乳房X线照片相类似;就边框评估而言,较高的分数表明,突出的组织更可能与健康的乳房组织相类似。

blocks.en:
A balanced subset of 100 synthetic images, spanning different breast density and BI-RADS categories, was evaluated by six radiologists. Each expert independently reviewed 40 full-image counterfactuals, such that each image received two to three evaluations.
Figure 3 presents three high-quality counterfactuals that received unanimous positive ratings (5/5) from all reviewing radiologists.
blocks.zh:
由100个合成图像组成的平衡子集,跨越了不同的乳房密度和BI-RADS类别,得到了6名放射学家的评价. 每个专家都独立审查了40个全图像反事实,因此每个图像都收到了2至3个评价。
图3列出了三个获得所有审查放射学家一致正面评价的高质量反事实(5/5)。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Three lesion-free counterfactual mammograms rated 5/5 for realism by all three reviewing radiologists. For each example, the original image is shown on the left and the corresponding counterfactual on the right. Zoomed views of the regions of interest are shown in the bottom row.
blocks.zh: 图3:所有三位审查放射学家对5/5的无损伤反事实乳房X光图评分. 对于每一个例子,原始图像显示在左边,相应的反事实显示在右边. 在下行显示感兴趣的区域的放大视图。

blocks.en: The rating distributions stratified by breast density are shown in Fig. 4 . Density D mammograms received the strongest overall ratings, while density C cases showed the largest proportion of upper-end ratings compared with densities A and B. This may be partly related to the greater prevalence of denser mammograms in the training dataset.
blocks.zh: 按乳房密度分级的评级分布在Fig中显示. 4. 密度 D型乳房X光检查获得了最强的整体收视率,而密度C型病例则显示与密度A和B相比,上端收视率比例最大. 这部分可能与培训数据集中更密集的乳房X光X光照片的更普遍有关。

blocks.en: Inpainting quality was also negatively correlated with lesion size (Fig. 4 ). Smaller lesions were reconstructed more convincingly, whereas larger masked regions tended to receive lower ratings.
blocks.zh: 油漆质量也与损伤大小有负关系(图4)。 较小的损伤得到更令人信服的重建,而较大的被遮住的区域往往得到较低的评价。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Radiologist evaluation of counterfactual realism for a balanced subset of counterfactuals. Left: Boxplot showing the distribution of mean realism ratings across breast density categories. Right: Scatter plot with linear regression illustrating the correlation between mean realism ratings and annotation area.
blocks.zh: 图4:放射学家对反事实现实主义的评价,以平衡地分集反事实. 左: Boxplot 显示乳房密度类别中平均现实主义收视率的分布. 对: 以线性回归来分解情节,说明平均现实主义收视率与注释区之间的关联.

blocks.en: 4.2 Data Augmentation
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 数据增强

blocks.en: Classification Performance
blocks.zh: 分类业绩

blocks.en:
Table 2 shows the effect of adding healthy counterfactual images as data augmentation across four classification backbones.
Recall and performance at fixed specificity (shown through Recall at 80% Spec.) improve consistently across all models. The largest recall gains are observed for ConvNeXt and FPN-MIL, with improvements of 4.6% and 1.9%, respectively. Improvements in recall at 80% specificity range from 0.6% to 1.3%, suggesting that counterfactual augmentation can improve sensitivity under a clinically relevant operating constraint. Balanced accuracy and F1-score show modest improvements across all models.
blocks.zh:
表2显示在四个分类主干线上增加健康反事实图像作为数据增强的效果。
在所有模型中,在固定特异性(通过回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回回 ConvNEXt和FPN-MIL的回收收益最大,分别为4.6%和1.9%。 80%的特异性恢复率从0.6%到1.3%,这表明在临床相关操作制约下,反事实增强可以提高敏感性。 平衡精度和F1分数在所有模型中都略有改善。

blocks.en: Specificity and ROC-AUC reveal a more mixed pattern. While specificity improves slightly for ViT, it decreases for ConvNeXt, Mammo-CLIP, and FPN-MIL. ROC-AUC improves modestly for ViT and Mammo-CLIP, but remains nearly unchanged for ConvNeXt and FPN-MIL.
blocks.zh: 特异性和ROC-AUC揭示出一种较为混杂的模式. 虽然ViT的特异性略有改善,但ConvNEXt、Mammo-CLIP和FPN-MIL的特异性却有所下降。 ROC-AUC在VIT和Mammo-CLIP方面略有改进,但在ConvNEXt和FPN-MIL方面几乎没有变化。

blocks.en: These results suggest that healthy counterfactual augmentation consistently improves sensitivity, particularly at the clinically relevant operating point of 80% specificity, while introducing a slight reduction in specificity for some models. Although gains in balanced accuracy, F1-score, and ROC-AUC are more modest, the improved sensitivity highlights the potential of the proposed augmentation strategy for computer-aided breast cancer screening, where reducing missed diagnoses is often prioritised.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,健康的反事实增强持续地提高敏感性,特别是在与临床相关的80%特异性操作点,同时对一些模型的特异性略作降低. 虽然在平衡准确性、F1分分数和ROC-AUC方面的进步比较小,但敏感性的提高突出了计算机辅助乳腺癌筛查拟议增强战略的潜力,在这种战略中,减少误诊往往被列为优先事项。

blocks.en: Table 2: Classification performance of ConvNeXt, ViT, Mammo-CLIP and FPN-MIL under baseline training and counterfactual augmentation (CF) on the original test set. Improved results are highlighted in bold. Recall values with fixed specificity (80%) are also reported.
blocks.zh: 表2:ConvNEXt、VIT、Mammo-CLIP和FPN-MIL在原测试集基线培训和反事实增强(CF)下的分类性能。 成果的改进用黑体突出。 还报告了具有固定特性(80%)的召回值。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced a diffusion-based counterfactual augmentation framework for mammography classification. The proposed method generates lesion-free counterfactuals by training a DDPM exclusively on healthy mammograms and applying RePaint-based inpainting within annotated lesion regions, while preserving the surrounding patient-specific anatomy.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们为乳房X光学分类引入了基于扩散的反事实增强框架. 拟议的方法产生无损伤的反事实,方法是专门对健康乳房X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X线X(DDPM)进行训练,并在附加说明的损伤区域应用基于RePaint的涂层,同时保留周围患者特有的解剖学.

blocks.en: Distributional metrics and expert reader assessments indicate that the generated images are consistent with real healthy mammograms. When used for data augmentation, they consistently improved sensitivity, particularly at a clinically relevant operating point of 80% specificity, across diverse classification architectures. Improvements in F1-score, balanced accuracy and ROC-AUC were more modest, while specificity slightly decreased for some models.
blocks.zh: 分布度量衡和专家读者评估表明所生成的图像与真正的健康乳房X光图一致. 当用于数据增强时,它们不断提高敏感性,特别是在临床上具有80%特异性的操作点,跨越不同的分类结构。 F1分数、平衡准确度和ROC-AUC的改进幅度较小,而某些模型的特异性略有下降。

blocks.en: Our work proposes healthy counterfactual generation as a strategy for data augmentation in mammography, producing realistic patient-specific lesion-free mammograms that consistently improve sensitivity across models with different inductive biases.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作提出,健康的反事实生成是乳房X光学中数据增强的战略,它产生现实的针对病人的无损伤乳房X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光X光
